segments.he: ר' שמואל אייזיק ראה פעם אליהו הנביא רץ ואמר לו להיכן רץ והשיב לו להלב של העולם. ושאל אותו מי הוא הלב של העולם והשיב לו לחסידי ברסלב שהם הלב של העולם.ועוד פ,א ראה אותו רץ ושאלו להיכן רץ והשיב לו לחסידי ברסלב שהם תמיד שותים;
segments.en:
When Moharan'as was traveling through the Ukraine with Reb Nachman of Tulchin, there was in some village along the way one of our fellowship who received them with the greatest warmth and with all his strength. He knew their travel schedule and would come out ahead of time on the road, take their bundles upon his shoulder, and bring Moharan'as and Reb Nachman to his home — serving all their needs of food, drink, and lodging, and even giving them some coins.

Once this man fell, G-d preserve us, into a great descent — so low he had nothing even to eat. Moharan'as and Reb Nachman were on the road and heard of his situation. They wanted to bypass that village so as not to burden him — but he already knew their schedule of when they traveled, and he stood on the main road and would not let them pass until he had brought them home. He set the table for them to eat. They did not want to — knowing the meal was insufficient for his own household — but he begged so earnestly that they should have mercy on him and eat, that they had no choice, in order to sustain him by this — and they began to eat.

But the food was "nit gezaltsn un nit geshmoltsn" [neither salted nor rendered] — it had no taste. He said to them: "Est! Est! Es iz in drosn vi zeyer kalt — es vet zikh der voremer varemen" [Eat! Eat! It is so cold outside — the warm food will warm you]. Moharan'as ate. But Reb Nachman of Tulchin could not eat such food. Moharan'as said to him: "Po'el bay zikh — es iz gut" [Work within yourself — it is good]. He began to do so — and Reb Nachman said that he literally tasted in the food the flavors of all dishes. For the essential thing is the feeling in the mind: "Az men po'elt bay zikh es iz gut, felt men taki az es iz gut" [When one works upon oneself that it is good, one truly feels it is good].
